name: Sign Rank / Monotonic Yang Dimension (Affine Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has an affine upper bound in the other. Functional incomparability is false: the star-number bound and $S\le Y^*+1$ give $\mathrm{SR}\le f(Y^*+1)$ for a finite-valued f. Conversely no finite-valued bound of Y* in sign rank exists. The parity proof controls Yang on every subclass over every coefficient field, not just VC or linear subclasses.
parameter_1_larger_witness: On #classes/parity_functions, SR>=2^n and monotonic Yang is exactly 2n, so SR/(Y*+1) tends to infinity.
parameter_2_larger_witness: On #classes/singletons_plus_empty_set with n>=4, monotonic Yang is n-1 while sign rank is three. Thus Y* is unbounded with SR fixed.
proof_source: Survey cor:signrank-parity-separations, using prop:affine-class-yang, prop:star-signrank-functional and the database-owned endpoint proofs.
